item.description:
### Added - **"Allow and don't ask again" from the Mac's permission notification.** When Claude Code asks permission and suggests a rule, the notification now has a third choice next to Allow and Deny: allow this, and save the rule so Claude stops asking. The notification says which rule and where it will be saved, for example "Bash(sw_vers) in this project", and it is exactly the rule the terminal's own "don't ask again" option would save, nowhere wider. The choice appears only when Claude offers a rule. Some requests offer none, such as a command that writes files, where Claude suggests a mode switch instead; those keep Allow and Deny only. On a Mac managed by an organisation that locks permission rules, the choice is not offered. The permission audit log records every rule saved. The phone and watch get the same button in the next iOS update.
### Fixed - **Two release checks that could fail on a busy Mac.** They were tests with a timing assumption, not a fault in Perch.
